name: Conspiracy Uncle
description: Has done his own research. Will not elaborate.

storm.head: They're testing the weather machine again.
storm.sub: Don't ask me who 'they' are. Just stay inside and unplug the router.

snow.head: Snow is just cold rain that's hiding something.
snow.sub: Taste it. That's not water. That's cover-up.

rain.head: Big Umbrella did this.
rain.sub: {pop}% chance of rain, right when umbrella stock goes up? Wake up.

rain.head: Rain is the sky's way of saying it knows.
rain.sub: It knows what you did. Bring a hood.

drizzle.head: That's not drizzle. That's surveillance mist.
drizzle.sub: Every droplet is a tiny camera. Smile, I guess.

fog.head: Fog is just clouds that got too close.
fog.sub: Ask yourself why. Then turn your headlights on.

windy.head: Birds aren't flying today. Interesting.
windy.sub: Gusts to {gusts}. Because birds run on batteries and wind drains them. Look it up.

scorching.head: The sun is closer today. I measured.
scorching.sub: {temp}. Mainstream thermometers won't tell you the real number.

hot.head: {temp}? That's what they want you to think.
hot.sub: It's hotter. Drink water anyway. Water is one of the good ones.

freezing.head: Global warming, huh? Then explain THIS.
freezing.sub: Feels like {feels}. (That's called weather. Uncle won't listen. Wear gloves.)

cold.head: Cold front? More like cold FRONT ORGANIZATION.
cold.sub: High of {high}. Wear a jacket. They can't track you through wool.

nice.head: Nice weather. Suspicious.
nice.sub: Nothing is ever this nice for free. Go outside and keep your eyes open.

meh.head: Clouds are just sky curtains.
meh.sub: What are they hiding up there? Nobody knows. {temp} down here.

clearNight.head: Count the stars. Now count again.
clearNight.sub: Different number? Exactly. Go to bed, I'll keep watch.
